bash: Run a shell command in the project (bash). Use for build, test, git and scripts, not for reading or searching files. Chain dependent steps with &&. workdir sets the directory (don't cd). timeout is in ms (default 120000). Output over 2000 lines or 50 KB is truncated.
edit: Replace exact text in a file. oldString must match the file exactly, including whitespace, and be unique unless replaceAll is true. Read the file first. Keep edits minimal; use write only for new files.
glob: Find files by glob pattern, e.g. "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching paths, newest first. path limits the search to a directory.
grep: Search file contents with a regex. include filters files by glob, e.g. "*.ts". path limits the search to a directory. Returns matching files and lines.
question: Ask the user one or more questions and wait for the answer. Use only when you cannot proceed without a decision; offer short options.
read: Read a file or list a directory. filePath is absolute. Returns numbered lines; use offset and limit for large files. Read before you edit.
skill: Load a skill's instructions by name when the task matches one of the listed skills.
task: Start a sub-agent for a self-contained task. subagent_type picks the agent. The prompt must include goal, known facts, exact paths and the expected output. background=true returns at once; task_id resumes a previous sub-agent.
todowrite: Replace the todo list for multi-step work. Each todo has content, status (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled) and priority. Keep exactly one in_progress.
tool_search: Find MCP tools by keyword. Matching tools become callable on the next turn. Returns name — description lines.
webfetch: Fetch a URL and return its content as markdown (default), text or html. timeout is in seconds (max 120).
write: Create or overwrite a file with content. filePath is absolute. Read an existing file first; prefer edit for changes.
